prompt: Did the affidavit say anything false, or leave out something police knew?

options.label: It left out something police knew

prompt: Which of these apply to the false statement or omission? Select all that apply.

options.label: The affiant's own report, notes, or recordings contradict it
The affiant knew the omitted fact when writing the affidavit (e.g. it's in their own report)
Other officers on the case knew the truth
It came from a source the affiant had reason to doubt (e.g. an informant with a history of bad information)
The affiant stated it as fact with no source for it
It looks like a typo or clerical error (e.g. wrong date or address)
